name: Staked FRAX
oneLiner: sFRAX is Frax's legacy-FRAX savings vault; protocol-funded rewards accrue to shares redeemable for pro-rata FRAX, without a guaranteed yield.
collateral: Legacy FRAX held by the StakedFrax vault, including protocol-funded FRAX rewards; Frax reserve and yield-source exposure remains upstream
pegMechanism: Deposit legacy FRAX to mint ERC-4626 shares and redeem for the current pro-rata FRAX amount. Weekly protocol-funded FRAX rewards are distributed linearly subject to an administrator-set cap; the IORB yield target is not guaranteed.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum deployment 0xa663b02cf0a4b149d2ad41910cb81e23e1c41c32 is the fixed StakedFrax ERC-4626 implementation over legacy FRAX at 0x853d955acef822db058eb8505911ed77f175b99e. The holder has an operational pro-rata FRAX claim plus linear protocol-funded rewards, not direct title to Frax reserve assets. Local custody and reward accounting require a protocol-position review distinct from the parent. Exact implementation creation is pinned by transaction 0xecd4ab27bc3b4c300b11405fc6a156ee316ad3f4c24f63130cbcbc49ae6bef55, block 18378085, timestamp 2023-10-18T15:19:11+00:00, independently joined from Blockscout to RPC receipt and block timestamp on2026-10-03. This is the implementation launch, not issuer founding or parent-token launch.
